**Revenue growth comparison:**

| Year | Sea revenue growth (YoY) | Grab revenue growth (YoY) | Faster grower |
|---|---|---|---|
| FY2024 | 28.75% ($13,063.6M → $16,819.9M) [Sea, FY2024, p.92] | 18.57% ($2,359M → $2,797M) [Grab, FY2024, p.128] | **Sea** |
| FY2025 | 36.38% ($16,819.9M → $22,938.5M) [Sea, FY2025, p.96] | 20.49% ($2,797M → $3,370M) [Grab, FY2025, p.88] | **Sea** |

In both FY2024 and FY2025, **Sea Limited** grew its total revenue faster than Grab Holdings — roughly 29% vs. 19% in FY2024, and about 36% vs. 20% in FY2025. Notably, Sea's growth rate also accelerated year-over-year, while Grab's growth rate was more modest and improved only slightly between the two years.
